name: v3.5
body:
# v3.5

v3.5 is mostly a fix-and-polish release after the big v3.4.  We burned down the open issues backlog, and out of that came a rebuilt PostgreSQL loader, a new native DuckDB loader, and three security fixes.

## Security fixes

Nine people reported three security issues in VisiData (eight of them found the same zip slip):

- **pandas**: `.pickle` files are no longer loaded unless the new `pandas_allow_pickle` option is set (default off).  Unpickling runs arbitrary code from the file, so opening an untrusted `.pickle` could execute it.  CVE pending, reported by @Santoshkumarpuppala.
- **unzip_http**: refuse zip members whose path resolves outside the extraction directory (Zip Slip).  CVE-2026-41958, reported by @MaxFreedomPollard, and independently by @robsherw of Cisco Talos and six others.  Also fixed in [unzip-http](https://github.com/saulpw/unzip-http) 0.8.
- **eml**: `gx` refuses attachment filenames that resolve outside the extraction directory (path traversal).  CVE-2026-42532, reported by @robsherw of Cisco Talos.

You should upgrade if you open files from sources you don't trust.

## Data changes

- Dict and list cells now save as JSON by default in text formats. (#2944)
- On the Describe sheet, all null forms count as one distinct value. (#3223)

## Interface changes

- **Join** type `concat` matches columns by position and keeps the first sheet's column names (and type as before).  Use `append` to match by name. (#3208)
- **Macros** record literal `{braces}` safely (f-strings and regexes no longer turn into parameters), and `{{ }}` escapes braces in parameterized macros. (#2785)
- **Command line args** are now added in order @midichef (#3225)
- **Options**: reading an undefined option warns and returns None, instead of raising.

## New commands

- `set-envvar` to record environment changes for replay (for e.g. $LC_ALL reproducibility). (#3195)
- `addcol-incr-key`, like `addcol-incr` but increment restarts at each change in key columns
- `select-col-duplicates` to select duplicate cells in one column @midichef
- `resize-col-max-all` and `resize-cols-max-all` to resize columns looking at all rows (#2780)
- `syscopy-sql` (#2393)
- `undo-redo-input` (`zU`) undoes the last change and reruns it with its input prefilled, for e.g. fixing a typo in a long expression. (#3031)
- `llm-query-sheet` and `llm-query-selected` send rows as one query to an Anthropic LLM; stream replies into the sheet (#2947)

## Highlighted features

- **PostgreSQL loader overhaul**: open a table directly with `postgres://host/dbname/tablename`, run `exec-sql`/`edit-sql`, and browse large tables that load lazily and stream rows.  Connection details come from libpq (via `$PGUSER`, `$PGHOST`, `~/.pgpass`, etc).  Tables are readonly for now; write support is deferred to a later release. (#282 #586 #727 #2989)
- **Native DuckDB loader** for `.duckdb` files, including saver. (#3035 #3237)
- **Decimal type**: `type-decimal` parses currency and `(1,234.50)` accounting negatives and keeps the source precision.  Unbound by default; bind it to `$` to try it. (#2396)
- **Command-server client**: include the `vdx` script to interact with a live `vd` command-server (LLMs can drive vd now too!)
- **.vds format**: several improvements to VisiData's own save format

## Spit and Polish

- **Hidden columns** keep their width across hide/unhide; sheet edge requires extra `go-right` before stepping into hidden columns. (#3214 #3215)
- **Better wide-character support**: fix terminal display issues with emoji and wide characters, and also better wrapping for same. (#2416 #2685)
- **Archives**: members decompress by suffix, nested tars open, and `zEnter` opens a member as a chosen filetype. (#3212)
- **macOS**: respect `XDG_DATA_HOME`/`XDG_STATE_HOME` on macOS

Thanks to @midichef for many bugfixes and reviews, and to @VXNCXNX, @danielwe, @chutzimir, @mpr1255, @horizonbymuneeb, @chiliec, @dacodas, @maxfain, and @khughitt for their contributions.

Please see the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/saulpw/visidata/blob/v3.5/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list of changes.
